findings.surface: pipeline: A1 producers vs page publish
findings.observed: The 2026-10-02 page (republished 14:17:10Z, batch fast-a1-publish-1002f) serves A1 tables built at 11:03-11:04Z. That was BEFORE the G1 refresh at 11:11Z, which added the 2026-10-01 reports of 7 funds (ETFT, INEQ, PCLG, PFOE, TSEL, TXUE, WCMG), and before G4 date=2026-10-01 landed at 11:10Z. The manifest's a1_produced reads SKIPPED for holding_contribution, buying_trend and input_census: '1 object(s) already at date=2026-10-02'.
findings.design_rule: A VALUE MUST CARRY ITS CLAIM

cause.text: The A1 producers skip when an object for the date already exists, so no later input refresh rebuilds them, and the publish does not compare the A1 tables' input vintage with the G1/G4 objects it reads itself.
cause.evidence: manifest.json a1_produced (SKIPPED x3); S3 LastModified: holding_contribution date=2026-10-02 11:03Z, input_census 11:04Z, canonical_shape date=2026-10-01 holdings-20261002T111038Z 11:11Z, security_market date=2026-10-01 11:10Z

findings.acceptance: When a G1 or G4 object newer than an A1 table's newest input lands, the next publish rebuilds that A1 table, or refuses to show it as current. A planted newer G1 object forces the rebuild.

findings.observed: The page contradicts itself. The header reads '13 of 13 funds current' (twice), while 'Inputs that did not arrive' reads 'Fund holdings files: 2 of 13 arrived, 11 missing or stale' and lists TXUE, PFOE, WCMG and others as 'no G1 report dated 2026-10-01'. The publish-time freshness check reads those same funds' latest report as 2026-10-01 (lag 0).

cause.text: The census was produced at 11:04Z (RFW-D01); the freshness check runs at publish over newer G1.
cause.evidence: manifest checks.report_date_freshness vs the input_census text; RFW-D01

findings.acceptance: On one page the fund-current headline and the census's holdings line agree (same G1 vintage), or the page names the vintage gap.

findings.surface: What drove the return, MTD and QTD
findings.observed: Month to date and quarter to date rank 0 holdings for 12 of 13 funds (every fund but BASG, which ranks 32). Each shows four empty tables ('No holding added to the return'). The page OPENS on Month to date.

cause.text: Page 2026-10-02 has asof 2026-10-01 (CALL 3), so MTD/QTD = one day. A day's return needs reports on both 09-30 and 10-01, and the A1 build at 11:03Z saw 10-01 reports for 2 funds only (RFW-D01).
cause.evidence: data-ranked/data-missing per fund-period: IDVZ 0/40, TXUE 0/49, BIDD 0/48, CGIC 0/193, INEQ 0/101, SCHY 0/104, PFOE 0/22, WCMG 0/47, GQGU 0/38, TSEL 0/27, ETFT 0/28, PCLG 0/28, BASG 32/1

findings.acceptance: After RFW-D01 lands, MTD ranks at least one holding for every fund whose 09-30 and 10-01 reports are both in G1; a fund-period with no priced day shows ONE line, not four empty tables (RFW-U03).

findings.observed: Inputs that did not arrive: 'Security prices: 0 of 765 arrived' and 'GICS sectors: 0 of 765 arrived'. G4 date=2026-10-01 holds 32 rows against the 765 security-days the page needs, and G4 history otherwise holds one date (2026-09-29).
findings.known_ref: ROUND_ANALYSIS.round5.md section 4 cell 7 (S14 G4 price cell)

cause.text: The daily G4 Bloomberg enrichment (prices plus GICS) is not running at universe scale. Known as the round-6 S14 G4 price cell.
cause.evidence: S3 security_market date=2026-10-01 market-20261002T111038Z: 32 rows; census text

findings.acceptance: G4 for the as-of date carries px_close and gics_sector for at least 95% of the universe's priced holdings, and the census reads that share.

findings.observed: For all 9 Bloomberg-sourced funds (TXUE, BIDD, CGIC, INEQ, SCHY, WCMG, TSEL, ETFT, PCLG), holdings show raw Bloomberg tickers instead of names: '8306 JP Equity', 'TTE FP Equity', '2330 TT Equity'. That is 26-40 per fund on the YTD view, and 496 distinct raw ids such as 'EOAN_GR_Equity' in the audit trail. The issuer and home funds (IDVZ, PFOE, GQGU, BASG) show names.

cause.text: The Bloomberg BQL capture carries no security name field into silver and G1, so the display falls back to the ticker (cause inferred; the capture's columns were not read). The symptom is measured.
cause.evidence: YTD ranking rows per fund with raw-ticker names: TXUE 40, BIDD 40, CGIC 39, INEQ 40, SCHY 40, WCMG 26, TSEL 26, ETFT 34, PCLG 26; 496 distinct *_Equity ids in page text

findings.acceptance: Every holding on the face shows a security name. A raw ticker appears only as secondary text, and the count of nameless holdings is 0, or each is listed in the census.

findings.observed: 'Unclassified' is ranked as a sector in the YTD sector tables of 10 funds, and is the single largest sector in 6: ETFT -6.59%, BASG -3.00%, TSEL -2.93%, BIDD -2.28%, TXUE -0.77% (weakest), and GQGU +3.83% (the STRONGEST). 'Sectors not shown' (most contribution unclassified) appears for IDVZ, INEQ, PFOE, ETFT and PCLG, and in GQGU's trend. 'No GICS sector in the source' is BASG's top trend sector away (-26,612,661 of 70,162,415 traded).

cause.text: G4 requested only securities with a Bloomberg id in G1's date=<D> partition, so CUSIP-only lines and funds without a report for <D> were never requested; Bloomberg-channel files carry GICS intermittently; the rankings had no cross-fund fallback (measured: census and replay).
cause.evidence: YTD sector tables per fund; 8 'No GICS sector in the source' rows

findings.acceptance: Per the GICS census (docs/briefs/rivalfunds-gics-census-20261002.md section 6, measured): each fund's YTD Unclassified share of absolute contribution is printed. After fix 1 (cross-fund GICS in the rankings), the replay shares hold (INEQ 22.2%, ETFT 30.0%, BIDD 3.1%, SCHY 6.0%, TXUE 1.9% on page day 2026-10-02). After fixes 2-3 (G4 requests every fund's latest report, CUSIP lines by CUSIP), no GICS-eligible security in a fund's latest report is Unclassified unless Bloomberg returned no sector for it, each such security listed. The earlier unmeasured 10% is withdrawn.
